newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh tea production rises, price falls.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh tea production rises, price falls.

text.p: Bangladesh tea production has increased by nearly six million kilograms this year but prices are falling, brokers said on Sunday.
They said the drop in price was due to higher yields in all tea-growing countries.
Tea production in Bangladesh was 44.7 million kg between January and October, compared with 38.8 million kg in the corresponding period of last year.
Total production for the year is forecast at 54 million kg.
The average auction price dropped 3.42 taka per kg to 44.7 kg, brokers said after the last weekly auction held in Chittagong on Tuesday.
They said tea output had gone up in all producing countries including India, Sri Lanka and Kenya.
"Bangladesh tea is facing a tough challege in the global market. The price may go down further," one broker said.
